## Activity

During March 2024, North City Eye Clinic completed 572 captures. Activity was recorded for the month as planned, with session lists running as scheduled apart from routine leave. The reported volume reflects the work completed by the clinic team during the reporting period. No additional operational issues were noted in the information provided for this report.

## Image quality

Image quality performance was stable across the reporting period. There were 9 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 1.6. This result is reported alongside the total capture activity and provides a measure of the images that could not proceed through grading. The ungradable activity should continue to be monitored through routine site review.

## Grading

A total of 129 results were graded as referable. The median grading lag was 3. This provides the summary measure for the time taken between image capture and completion of grading during March 2024. Overall, the report records the site’s activity, image quality, and grading outcomes for the month.
